title: From paper to the open sea

story.about: A tiny folded paper idea becomes a full-size real sailing vessel and a cinematic voyage.
story.whyCare: You can imagine a film without having the footage or a crew to shoot it.
story.hook: A paper boat on a workbench gains water; a decisive transformation reveals a full-size real yacht.
story.beginning: One small recognisable paper boat and a blank sheet.
story.development: Water lifts the idea; paper folds give way to timber, canvas sails and real rigging.
story.tension: Can this tiny imagined thing become a believable world? The yacht meets open-sea scale and waves.
story.payoff: A real vessel cuts through moving ocean under opening light. The actual generated shots appear inside AutoPromote Studio.
story.ending: A cinematic AutoPromote ident resolves the reveal that this began with an idea and no recorded footage.
story.withheld: The real vessel until after the paper setup; the tool identity until the creation reveal.
